build_gui_drawer: build a GuiDrawer instance with DebugLineRender and ClientMessageManager to render UI elements in Habitat simulation
draw_box: draw a colored 3D box in world-space using min and max extent vectors with GuiDrawer
draw_circle: draw a colored circle at a given translation with a specified radius and normal vector
draw_transformed_line: draw a line segment with interpolated colors between two 3D points using GuiDrawer
push_pop_transform: push and pop a Matrix4 transform to apply local-space transformations to subsequent drawing calls
